```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(yaml)

edu      <- yaml::read_yaml("data/education.yml")
appts    <- yaml::read_yaml("data/appointments.yml")
grants   <- yaml::read_yaml("data/grants.yml")
awards   <- yaml::read_yaml("data/awards.yml")
talks    <- yaml::read_yaml("data/talks.yml")
teaching <- yaml::read_yaml("data/teaching.yml")[[1]]
service  <- yaml::read_yaml("data/service.yml")
pubs     <- read.csv("publications.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

# Helper: emit raw HTML/markdown
cat_md <- function(...) knitr::asis_output(paste0(..., collapse = "\n"))

# Helper: year label (handles both 'year' and 'years' keys)
yr <- function(x) if (!is.null(x$years)) x$years else as.character(x$year)
```

## Education

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
rows <- sapply(edu, function(x)
  sprintf("<tr><td style='width:4rem;color:#666'>%s</td><td>%s, %s</td></tr>",
          x$year, x$degree, x$institution))
cat_md("<table style='border:none'>", rows, "</table>")
```

## Appointments

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
rows <- sapply(appts, function(x)
  sprintf("<tr><td style='width:7rem;color:#666;vertical-align:top'>%s</td><td>%s, %s</td></tr>",
```

## Publications

*(\\* indicates graduate student co-author)*

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
types <- list(
  list(label = "Books",                filter = "book"),
  list(label = "Refereed Articles",    filter = "article"),
  list(label = "Book Chapters",        filter = "chapter"),
  list(label = "Working Papers",       filter = "working"),
  list(label = "Op-Eds, Book Reviews, and Other", filter = "other")
)

fmt_pub <- function(p) {
  doi_link <- if (!is.na(p$doi) && nchar(p$doi))
    sprintf(' <a href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank">[DOI]</a>', p$doi) else ""
  sprintf('<p style="margin-bottom:0.6rem">%s (%s). "%s." <em>%s</em>%s%s</p>',
          p$authors, p$year, p$title,
          ifelse(is.na(p$venue), "", p$venue),
          ifelse(is.na(p$volume_issue_pages) || !nchar(p$volume_issue_pages), "",
                 paste0(" ", p$volume_issue_pages, ".")),
          doi_link)
}

for (t in types) {
  sub <- pubs[pubs$type == t$filter & pubs$status == "published", ]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  sub <- sub[order(-sub$year), ]
  cat_md(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", t$label))
  cat_md(sapply(seq_len(nrow(sub)), function(i) fmt_pub(sub[i,])))
}
```

## Grants & Fellowships

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
rows <- sapply(grants, function(x)
  sprintf('<tr><td style="width:7rem;color:#666;vertical-align:top">%s</td>
           <td><strong>%s</strong><br>%s · %s%s</td></tr>',
          yr(x), x$title, x$role, x$funder,
          if (!is.null(x$amount)) paste0(" · ", x$amount) else ""))
cat_md("<table style='border:none'>", rows, "</table>")
```

## Presentations

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
years <- sort(unique(sapply(talks, `[[`, "year")), decreasing = TRUE)
for (y in years) {
  yr_talks <- Filter(function(x) x$year == y, talks)
  cat_md(sprintf("\n**%s**\n\n", y))
  items <- sapply(yr_talks, function(x) {
    inv <- if (isTRUE(x$invited)) " *(Invited)*" else ""
    sprintf('- "%s." %s, %s.%s\n', x$title, x$venue, x$location, inv)
  })
  cat_md(items)
}
```
